scope: Harness review, unit tests and one mechanics smoke run on a shared, loaded development host. Not the decision matrix and not evidence for or against parallel frontend threads.

review_fixes.defect: systemd-run expands ${...} in its arguments by default, which erased the scope wrapper's cgroup path; every job copied the root cgroup's cpu.stat (about 4.9 million CPU seconds) and found no memory.peak or memory.events.
review_fixes.fix: pass --expand-environment=no to systemd-run; the unit test asserts the flag and that the wrapper keeps ${path}
review_fixes.observed_after: per-job cpu_seconds 5.5 to 6.9, memory.peak 0.80 to 0.99 GB and oom_kill 0 in the smoke rows

review_fixes.defect: user Cargo configuration routes rustc through a kache build.rustc-wrapper, so measured compilations could be cache hits; build.jobs was also inherited from user configuration.
review_fixes.fix: every Cargo invocation sets RUSTC_WRAPPER and RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER empty, CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 and CARGO_BUILD_JOBS from --cargo-jobs; rows retain cargo_environment and analysis treats cargo_jobs as a control
review_fixes.observed_after: a probe crate's verbose rustc invocation names the kache wrapper without the override and does not with it; the smoke rows' rustc_commands contain no wrapper

review_fixes.defect: an unescaped percent sign in --cpu-quota help made argparse raise before admission, so the CLI could not start.
review_fixes.fix: escape the help text; a unit test drives main() and expects a usage refusal with no subprocess call

review_fixes.defect: each job's private copy of the warm target and both templates were retained, so a full matrix could exhaust disk.
review_fixes.fix: remove each private target after measurement and hashing, and each template after its toolchain's batches; rows record target_retained=false

smoke_run.purpose: Prove scope limits, counter capture, compiler invocation recording, analysis and cleanup execute end to end.
smoke_run.command: TMPDIR=/run/user/1555/kiln-pf-tmp CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true python3 scripts/parallel-frontend-bench.py --toolchain nightly-2026-07-22 --baseline-toolchain 1.88.0 --crate onix-kiln-core --threads 1,2 --concurrency 1,2 --repeats 1 --cpu-quota 200% --memory-max 2G --cargo-jobs 2 --source-revision jj-working-copy-d93d7737 --out /run/user/1555/kiln-pf-smoke
smoke_run.source_revision_note: uncommitted jj working copy over 470e8be3; not an exact source revision
smoke_run.analysis_outcome: every cell is insufficient (one repeat), so no recommendation

Write the recommendation, or decline one, from that retained evidence.
non_claims: The smoke timings came from a loaded shared host and one repeat; they are not comparable measurements.
